text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It's gotten better than at the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Really! Fufu, it's all thanks to
Ayabe-san keeping me company!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I'm keeping Narita Top Road and the others company for their dance lesson.
...However—

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
—Our senpais really are amazing!
—Go for it—!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! It really makes me happy to hear people cheering for me on campus, too.

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
“—I wanna dance with Top Road-senpai too~!”
“—H-Hey, we're in the middle of practice! Hold your horses.”

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...I think I'll take a break now.
Why don't you keep those girls company for the rest?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
B-But we only just got started—

text_block_list.name: Students
text_block_list.text:
—No way!?
—Me, pick me! Senpai, with me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah!? Please calm down, everyone!
I still have my lesson with Ayabe-san...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: !! ...Thank you so much!

text_block_list.text:
—Huh? ...What does this mean?
—C-Could we have caused some kind of trouble...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: You're right! If we convey it with all our sincerity.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the invitation, everyone!
However, today I mustâ

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I knew you'd be here!
I figured you'd be somewhere quiet
where you could see the sky.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
! Wait, did you follow me?
Those kids are waiting—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san, please continue!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I felt bad for the girls who invited me, but I had to turn them down.
After all—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I want to practice more with Ayabe-san,
and get our steps in sync even better.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Moving in perfect unison,
the fans erupted in cheers—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "—So that I can stand on the greatest Winning Live stage with you!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Um... Of course!
As long as Ayabe-san is okay with it, that is...!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
After saying all that, why get cold feet now?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"If we're doing this, let's start quickly.
Out here... nobody will come."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Whoa... Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road was able to practice to her heart's
content with Admire Vega for the live performance!
